faqs.a: According to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), homelessness is when an "individual or family lacks a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence." This includes people living on the streets as well as families and individuals transitioning among different settings, like short-stay motels, doubling-up with friends or family members, sleeping in cars or living in transitional housing or shelters.
